description: This file implements an Exchange 2013 calendar service with functionalities to create, update, delete, and retrieve calendar events and availability, using the ews-javascript-api library.

classes.name: ExchangeCalendarService
classes.description: A class implementing calendar operations for Exchange 2013, including event creation, updating, deletion, and availability checking.

methods.name: createEvent
methods.description: Creates a new calendar event in Exchange with specified details and attendees.

methods.name: updateEvent
methods.description: Updates an existing calendar event identified by UID with new details.

methods.name: deleteEvent
methods.description: Deletes a calendar event by moving it to the Deleted Items folder.

methods.name: getAvailability
methods.description: Retrieves busy dates for selected calendars within a specified date range.

methods.name: listCalendars
methods.description: Lists all available calendars in the Exchange account.

methods.name: getExchangeService
methods.description: Initializes and returns an ExchangeService instance configured with credentials and URL.
